annotation.summary_en: Book review in Technology and Language of Cheng Lin's "RoboHumanities", a humanities study of how robots are imagined, narrated and ethically discussed. The supplied text is actually a different issue of the journal (7(3), about machine learning and Llull), so the review's content could not be checked. Coding is based only on the title and metadata.
key_provisions_or_claims: Reviews a humanities-focused book on robot imaginaries, narratives and ethics
Title suggests a call to return from fictional imaginaries to the 'reality' of robots
Supplied text is a different journal issue (7(3)) and does not contain the review
